title: How it works: NVIDIA Nemotron reads, rules decide
caption: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B on Nebius Token Factory proposes fields; code and rules do the rest.
steps: HTTP 202 after the database commit; a transactional outbox queues the job.
Leases with heartbeat, retries with jitter, dead letters, idempotency.
Strict JSON schema, temperature 0; every field needs a verbatim quote.
Fields whose quote is not in the instruction are dropped.
The policy version valid on the payment date, the issuer's authority, the result.
